content: Central Ursus, Pine Valley Retreat, Dining Hall

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Sir, your coffee.

speaker: Veteran-Like Person
content: —Are you new?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I am, sir.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Veteran-Like Person"]  Then ask around about how I take my coffee. Bring it to me again once you let it cool!
speaker: Veteran-Like Person
content: Then ask around about how I take my coffee. Bring it to me again once you let it cool!

raw: [name="Veteran-Like Person"]  You damned Feline—eugh, a Feline! You disgusting wretch! I didn't go to war to have a Feline take care of me!
speaker: Veteran-Like Person
content: You damned Feline—eugh, a Feline! You disgusting wretch! I didn't go to war to have a Feline take care of me!

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Veteran-Like Person"]  Get out of my sight!
speaker: Veteran-Like Person
content: Get out of my sight!

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Kal'tsit"]  My utmost apologies, sir, this is my oversight.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: My utmost apologies, sir, this is my oversight.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Please don't tell the head caretaker. I'll prepare it again for you right away...
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Please don't tell the head caretaker. I'll prepare it again for you right away...

raw: [name="Veteran-Like Person"]  Hmph! If you don't want to lose your job, you have three minutes to do it over, properly.
speaker: Veteran-Like Person
content: Hmph! If you don't want to lose your job, you have three minutes to do it over, properly.

raw: [name="Veteran-Like Person"]  Also... is something wrong with your eyes? If you don't know how to smile, I'll tear that face of yours off.
speaker: Veteran-Like Person
content: Also... is something wrong with your eyes? If you don't know how to smile, I'll tear that face of yours off.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Please don't... I'm very sorry to displease you. I'll go and redo it right now.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Please don't... I'm very sorry to displease you. I'll go and redo it right now.

raw: [name="Veteran-Like Person"]  Peh. Servants these days. Is a nice figure all they have to offer?
speaker: Veteran-Like Person
content: Peh. Servants these days. Is a nice figure all they have to offer?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  I am very sorry, sir. Please do not get angry.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I am very sorry, sir. Please do not get angry.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  It would be highly detrimental to your condition.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: It would be highly detrimental to your condition.

speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Out of the way!

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Yes, yes. Very sorry.

speaker: Elderly Caretaker
content: Miss? Hey, Miss!

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Are you referring to me?

raw: [name="Elderly Caretaker"]  Yeah, that's right. Miss, I saw the whole thing just now. Don't you lose heart.
speaker: Elderly Caretaker
content: Yeah, that's right. Miss, I saw the whole thing just now. Don't you lose heart.

raw: [name="Elderly Caretaker"]  That's a Patrol Unit head... you know, you could say, people like that have no right coming to the retreat.
speaker: Elderly Caretaker
content: That's a Patrol Unit head... you know, you could say, people like that have no right coming to the retreat.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  He certainly isn't a noble... Does he not worry about offending others, acting so tyrannically?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: He certainly isn't a noble... Does he not worry about offending others, acting so tyrannically?

raw: [name="Elderly Caretaker"]  They say some count's very fond of him... ah, and not just that. Coming here for his 'battlefield condition?' I heard that's hokum. Bet he hasn't stepped foot on a battlefield in his life.
speaker: Elderly Caretaker
content: They say some count's very fond of him... ah, and not just that. Coming here for his 'battlefield condition?' I heard that's hokum. Bet he hasn't stepped foot on a battlefield in his life.

raw: [name="Elderly Caretaker"]  I heard he helped the count do some dirty work, and got sent here so he could keep his head down. With a supporter like that, and with people like us, of course he lets all hell's bells loose.
speaker: Elderly Caretaker
content: I heard he helped the count do some dirty work, and got sent here so he could keep his head down. With a supporter like that, and with people like us, of course he lets all hell's bells loose.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: ...A count...

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  I never imagined a scoundrel like that could climb high enough to befriend a count.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I never imagined a scoundrel like that could climb high enough to befriend a count.

raw: [name="Elderly Caretaker"]  That's how it is! Who knows when one day he'll be made some lord of somewhere! Dressed all clean and fine and sitting behind some enormous desk... agh.
speaker: Elderly Caretaker
content: That's how it is! Who knows when one day he'll be made some lord of somewhere! Dressed all clean and fine and sitting behind some enormous desk... agh.

raw: [name="Elderly Caretaker"]  Anyway, don't you get angry. Piss off people like that, and you'll wish it was an Originium Slug stuck to you instead. What on Terra is a fine young girl like you even doing, working out here...
speaker: Elderly Caretaker
content: Anyway, don't you get angry. Piss off people like that, and you'll wish it was an Originium Slug stuck to you instead. What on Terra is a fine young girl like you even doing, working out here...

raw: [name="Elderly Caretaker"]  Never tell anyone I told you this, and don't go asking about, or else you'll get burnt!
speaker: Elderly Caretaker
content: Never tell anyone I told you this, and don't go asking about, or else you'll get burnt!

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Yes... I understand. Thank you.

raw: [name="Elderly Caretaker"]  Ack. The next you see him, stay away a little. Heaven knows what he'll do to you—ah, is that the new doctor?
speaker: Elderly Caretaker
content: Ack. The next you see him, stay away a little. Heaven knows what he'll do to you—ah, is that the new doctor?

speaker: Lillia
content: Kal'tsit.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Doctor.

raw: [name="Elderly Caretaker"]  Oh, oh, so you know each other... then I'll get out of your way. Definitely not break time, after all. Take care, and don't let the head caretaker see you.
speaker: Elderly Caretaker
content: Oh, oh, so you know each other... then I'll get out of your way. Definitely not break time, after all. Take care, and don't let the head caretaker see you.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  She cares a lot about us newcomers. She's a good one.
speaker: Lillia
content: She cares a lot about us newcomers. She's a good one.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  You're right, Dr. Louisa. We cannot let her down.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You're right, Dr. Louisa. We cannot let her down.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Will you still be busy with work in a bit? There's some things I'd like to tell you.
speaker: Lillia
content: Will you still be busy with work in a bit? There's some things I'd like to tell you.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Apologies, doctor... I still need to brew a new cup of coffee. If that count's pet doesn't continue to pick bones with me, I'll find you right after.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Apologies, doctor... I still need to brew a new cup of coffee. If that count's pet doesn't continue to pick bones with me, I'll find you right after.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Alright, then... remember to be careful, Kal'tsit.
speaker: Lillia
content: Alright, then... remember to be careful, Kal'tsit.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Dr. Louisa.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  It's just us two right now, Kal'tsit. You should be using an alias.
speaker: Lillia
content: It's just us two right now, Kal'tsit. You should be using an alias.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  'Louisa.' Borrowing your daughter's name. A disguise of that level is purely for humiliating the Secret Police.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: 'Louisa.' Borrowing your daughter's name. A disguise of that level is purely for humiliating the Secret Police.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  In their eyes, I am already dead. And after this incident, I'll leave Ursus, and may not be able to return for a very long time.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: In their eyes, I am already dead. And after this incident, I'll leave Ursus, and may not be able to return for a very long time.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Nobody will know the Grand Duke's death was a murder. The next time they come to the Grand Duke's side, they will only discover that in his old age, his breathing stopped.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Nobody will know the Grand Duke's death was a murder. The next time they come to the Grand Duke's side, they will only discover that in his old age, his breathing stopped.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Will Ursus technology not be enough to analyze the poison you've made?
speaker: Lillia
content: Will Ursus technology not be enough to analyze the poison you've made?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  At present, I assure you this exceeds their understanding of what a 'poison' is.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: At present, I assure you this exceeds their understanding of what a 'poison' is.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  For how many years can your knowledge stay ahead of Ursus? Director?
speaker: Lillia
content: For how many years can your knowledge stay ahead of Ursus? Director?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  The Empire's progress has already surpassed what I imagined, but these are not details we need to discuss right now.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: The Empire's progress has already surpassed what I imagined, but these are not details we need to discuss right now.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Lillia, your hoped-for arbitration can only end in this way.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Lillia, your hoped-for arbitration can only end in this way.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  None of you have the means to seek further revenge; it is unreasonable. Only the paramount Emperor of Ursus would be capable of erasing the Grand Duke's honor, significance, and all else.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: None of you have the means to seek further revenge; it is unreasonable. Only the paramount Emperor of Ursus would be capable of erasing the Grand Duke's honor, significance, and all else.

speaker: Lillia
content: ...I know...

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Good. In that case, is this the place?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Good. In that case, is this the place?

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Yes. We have no idea what Grand Duke Vanya is chronically afflicted with.
speaker: Lillia
content: Yes. We have no idea what Grand Duke Vanya is chronically afflicted with.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  But I found out from the head caretaker that every afternoon at three, Vanya will leave his own monitoring room, and come here to relax.
speaker: Lillia
content: But I found out from the head caretaker that every afternoon at three, Vanya will leave his own monitoring room, and come here to relax.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  He sunbathes here until sunset. When he has the occasional guests, he'll have his dinner right here with them.
speaker: Lillia
content: He sunbathes here until sunset. When he has the occasional guests, he'll have his dinner right here with them.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  There's no way we can get close to the Grand Duke's room, but as for here...
speaker: Lillia
content: There's no way we can get close to the Grand Duke's room, but as for here...

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: We're standing right here.

speaker: Lillia
content: Yes.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  But he won't be without bodyguards. The whole corridor will be sealed off when the time comes.
speaker: Lillia
content: But he won't be without bodyguards. The whole corridor will be sealed off when the time comes.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Apart from any guests cleared to be with the Grand Duke, only his medical adviser, as well as the servants, are allowed to enter this area.
speaker: Lillia
content: Apart from any guests cleared to be with the Grand Duke, only his medical adviser, as well as the servants, are allowed to enter this area.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Even so, the Ursus nobles won't permit the workers to come to this balcony freely.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Even so, the Ursus nobles won't permit the workers to come to this balcony freely.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  We've already waited for long enough. The longer we spend, the riskier this gets.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: We've already waited for long enough. The longer we spend, the riskier this gets.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  I understand. There has to be some gap, there has to be an opening... the Grand Duke's medical advisers work in shifts, so it might be me before we know it. Today, or perhaps tomorrow.
speaker: Lillia
content: I understand. There has to be some gap, there has to be an opening... the Grand Duke's medical advisers work in shifts, so it might be me before we know it. Today, or perhaps tomorrow.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Lillia, tell me the truth.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  After the Grand Duke dies, what will you do?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: After the Grand Duke dies, what will you do?

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Why ask this now? We should be focusing on what's before us—
speaker: Lillia
content: Why ask this now? We should be focusing on what's before us—

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  I'm hoping you can answer me with reality.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I'm hoping you can answer me with reality.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Before we reached Pine Valley, I received one final letter from Vampilov's family.
speaker: Lillia
content: Before we reached Pine Valley, I received one final letter from Vampilov's family.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Sergei is still diligently serving Boris, and the city... has changed course. Perhaps this is the start of something changing.
speaker: Lillia
content: Sergei is still diligently serving Boris, and the city... has changed course. Perhaps this is the start of something changing.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  They killed so many people... yet their conscience is still so clear. They rest so easily...
speaker: Lillia
content: They killed so many people... yet their conscience is still so clear. They rest so easily...

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  You found out about Sergei's betrayal.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You found out about Sergei's betrayal.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  But no excuse can bring back the dead.
speaker: Lillia
content: But no excuse can bring back the dead.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Sergei can't offer any further scientific assistance. Perhaps in a few years, they'll formally call a halt to the project. And then? I just sit back and watch Sergei and Boris continue to collude, to trample over everything?
speaker: Lillia
content: Sergei can't offer any further scientific assistance. Perhaps in a few years, they'll formally call a halt to the project. And then? I just sit back and watch Sergei and Boris continue to collude, to trample over everything?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Though Grand Duke Vanya will be dead, you don't plan to stop.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Though Grand Duke Vanya will be dead, you don't plan to stop.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  There's no way I can pardon Sergei. The first time I met him, Astrov was drunk, hugging me so excited, telling me all about how he had such upstanding, excellent colleagues.
speaker: Lillia
content: There's no way I can pardon Sergei. The first time I met him, Astrov was drunk, hugging me so excited, telling me all about how he had such upstanding, excellent colleagues.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  He looked forward to this project like no one else, and I supported him. I supported him with all I could.
speaker: Lillia
content: He looked forward to this project like no one else, and I supported him. I supported him with all I could.

speaker: Lillia
content: Even up to now.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Director Kal'tsit, you know everything, don't you?
speaker: Lillia
content: Director Kal'tsit, you know everything, don't you?

raw: [name="Lillia"]  If you won't speak up, I'll return to Chernobog. I'll settle things once and for all.
speaker: Lillia
content: If you won't speak up, I'll return to Chernobog. I'll settle things once and for all.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Vampilov's family have an escape route to Sami ready for me, but maybe, I wouldn't get the chance to hitchhike with any Messengers. And you...
speaker: Lillia
content: Vampilov's family have an escape route to Sami ready for me, but maybe, I wouldn't get the chance to hitchhike with any Messengers. And you...

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I do plan to.

speaker: Lillia
content: Heh... of course.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  I'm very well aware, I'm setting myself alight. So... Kal'tsit, no matter whether you plan to confess all the facts to me or not, at the very least there's one tiny thing I want you to agree to.
speaker: Lillia
content: I'm very well aware, I'm setting myself alight. So... Kal'tsit, no matter whether you plan to confess all the facts to me or not, at the very least there's one tiny thing I want you to agree to.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  I know I'm doing something insane right now, and I know maybe you're the one in the right. But right now, I only have one request. Look after my daughter. Look after Louisa.
speaker: Lillia
content: I know I'm doing something insane right now, and I know maybe you're the one in the right. But right now, I only have one request. Look after my daughter. Look after Louisa.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  The next generation doesn't need to inherit the hassle of hatred... Even if nobody can escape this cycle in the end, at least promise me, Kal'tsit. Look after her. If you can, please look after Lyudmila too...
speaker: Lillia
content: The next generation doesn't need to inherit the hassle of hatred... Even if nobody can escape this cycle in the end, at least promise me, Kal'tsit. Look after her. If you can, please look after Lyudmila too...

raw: [name="Caretaker's Voice"]  Dr. Louisa? Dr. Louisa, where are you?
speaker: Caretaker's Voice
content: Dr. Louisa? Dr. Louisa, where are you?

speaker: Lillia
content: Here! Please wait one moment!

speaker: Lillia
content: Kal'tsit... I...

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I promise you.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  This is simply a mother's final wish. I will see Louisa grow up.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: This is simply a mother's final wish. I will see Louisa grow up.

speaker: Lillia
content: Thank you.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Astrov—the last time he held little Louisa's hand, he told me something, half-jokingly.
speaker: Lillia
content: Astrov—the last time he held little Louisa's hand, he told me something, half-jokingly.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  He said, he hoped little Louisa would become a medical researcher just like me, and when Louisa was old enough to go to school, he hoped you'd be her very first teacher.
speaker: Lillia
content: He said, he hoped little Louisa would become a medical researcher just like me, and when Louisa was old enough to go to school, he hoped you'd be her very first teacher.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I see...

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Those were the very last words he said to his daughter before he suddenly went to the Institute that night.
speaker: Lillia
content: Those were the very last words he said to his daughter before he suddenly went to the Institute that night.

raw: [name="Elderly Caretaker"]  Oh, doctor, here you are! Perfect, if you were any later, the head caretaker would've gone ballistic.
speaker: Elderly Caretaker
content: Oh, doctor, here you are! Perfect, if you were any later, the head caretaker would've gone ballistic.

raw: [name="Elderly Caretaker"]  Hm? Doctor, what's got your eyes all red? Did something happen?
speaker: Elderly Caretaker
content: Hm? Doctor, what's got your eyes all red? Did something happen?

speaker: Lillia
content: Nothing. What's the matter?

raw: [name="Elderly Caretaker"]  It's time to make rounds.
speaker: Elderly Caretaker
content: It's time to make rounds.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  I wasn't even paying attention... right, I understand.
speaker: Lillia
content: I wasn't even paying attention... right, I understand.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Is there some kind of commotion over there?
speaker: Lillia
content: Is there some kind of commotion over there?

raw: [name="Elderly Caretaker"]  Yes, seems an old nobleman's come from far off. Don't know for what.
speaker: Elderly Caretaker
content: Yes, seems an old nobleman's come from far off. Don't know for what.

raw: [name="Elderly Caretaker"]  As long as the days go by smooth, that's what matters.
speaker: Elderly Caretaker
content: As long as the days go by smooth, that's what matters.

speaker: Lillia
content: Hello—

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Excuse me, we're currently making rounds... It seems you weren't on the list of scheduled visitors. Can I ask who you are?
speaker: Lillia
content: Excuse me, we're currently making rounds... It seems you weren't on the list of scheduled visitors. Can I ask who you are?

raw: [name="???"]  Just an Ursus citizen here on a whim, looking to meet an old friend. Do carry on, madam.
content: Just an Ursus citizen here on a whim, looking to meet an old friend. Do carry on, madam.

raw: [name="???"]  I hope I don't bother any of you in your work.
content: I hope I don't bother any of you in your work.

speaker: Veteran-Like Person
content: Witte, are you off?

raw: [name="???"]  No, old friend, I'll see you again in a bit. You should be more mindful of your health, with winter here. Don't set off that asthma of yours.
content: No, old friend, I'll see you again in a bit. You should be more mindful of your health, with winter here. Don't set off that asthma of yours.

raw: [name="???"]  As you were, madam. I'll be waiting in the hall.
content: As you were, madam. I'll be waiting in the hall.

speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Minister Witte!
Do watch out.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Ah, I, sorry...

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  The Grand Duke didn't know you were visiting. It's our negligence on the job to blame. As a token of apology, the Grand Duke would like you to have dinner with him.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: The Grand Duke didn't know you were visiting. It's our negligence on the job to blame. As a token of apology, the Grand Duke would like you to have dinner with him.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  We hope you understand, the Grand Duke is ill, and if not for that, he would've greeted you himself...
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: We hope you understand, the Grand Duke is ill, and if not for that, he would've greeted you himself...

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Veteran-Like Person
content: Huff.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Ah, I'm sorry, I'm greatly sorry...
speaker: Lillia
content: Ah, I'm sorry, I'm greatly sorry...

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  What's wrong with you! In the presence of the Minister—
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: What's wrong with you! In the presence of the Minister—

raw: [name="Veteran-Like Person"]  Oh, nothing, just some alcohol spilled on the bedsheets.
speaker: Veteran-Like Person
content: Oh, nothing, just some alcohol spilled on the bedsheets.
Calm down. Madam, what happened?

raw: [name="Lillia"]  I'm sorry, the cap on the isopropyl bottle was too tight, and I applied too much force...
speaker: Lillia
content: I'm sorry, the cap on the isopropyl bottle was too tight, and I applied too much force...

content: You could've just asked someone else to help.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Sorry, so sorry, I'll go and fetch a towel right now...

content: Sorry, so sorry, I'll go and fetch a towel right now...
Poor her.

raw: [name="???"]  As for the Grand Duke's invitation, I do regret that my Messenger is still waiting for me, and I can't stay so long.
content: As for the Grand Duke's invitation, I do regret that my Messenger is still waiting for me, and I can't stay so long.

raw: [name="???"]  Do pass a message on to Vanya. Tell him to rest up with peace of mind here. Though he should remember, also, that this is a meritorious place for those Our Majesty gives favor, and not another social hub for the nobility to mingle in.
content: Do pass a message on to Vanya. Tell him to rest up with peace of mind here. Though he should remember, also, that this is a meritorious place for those Our Majesty gives favor, and not another social hub for the nobility to mingle in.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  Ah... got it, got it... if you could just hold on... the Grand Duke will be very sad to hear.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Ah... got it, got it... if you could just hold on... the Grand Duke will be very sad to hear.

raw: [name="???"]  This is official business. If I have to choose between Our Majesty and the Grand Duke, I'm forced to wrong the Grand Duke Vanya.
content: This is official business. If I have to choose between Our Majesty and the Grand Duke, I'm forced to wrong the Grand Duke Vanya.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  Ergh...! You should've spoke sooner! If that's so, the Grand Duke will surely empathize with you.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Ergh...! You should've spoke sooner! If that's so, the Grand Duke will surely empathize with you.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  May your road be evergreen.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: May your road be evergreen.
Send him my regards.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Dr. Louisa, what's wrong...?

speaker: Lillia
content: Kal'tsit, who is he?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Viscount Islam Witte.

speaker: Lillia
content: You recognize him...?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Ursus's new Minister of Finance, a fresh noble with deep favor from the Emperor.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Ursus's new Minister of Finance, a fresh noble with deep favor from the Emperor.

speaker: Lillia
content: He...

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: It's alright, Dr. Louisa.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  I have only surface knowledge of his character, and don't know specifically how he made his fortune. But what I do know is, he's a present pillar who the Emperor of Ursus has personally assisted.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I have only surface knowledge of his character, and don't know specifically how he made his fortune. But what I do know is, he's a present pillar who the Emperor of Ursus has personally assisted.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  And young elites like him can only have their sights set on the whole of Ursus. To the waves of crisis crashing against the Empire, the crises of Chernobog are mere tiny ripples.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: And young elites like him can only have their sights set on the whole of Ursus. To the waves of crisis crashing against the Empire, the crises of Chernobog are mere tiny ripples.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Even a Grand Duke of Ursus—
